title: Paginate user results
prContext: Added a paginate() helper so the /users endpoint can return results page by page.
explanation: Pages are documented as 1-indexed, but the start offset is computed as if they were 0-indexed. Requesting page 1 skips the first per_page items entirely, and the last page always comes back empty.
whyAiDoesThis: Models have seen both 0-indexed and 1-indexed pagination thousands of times and blend them, writing the docstring for one convention and the arithmetic for the other.

title: Search products by name
prContext: Implemented the product search endpoint with a case-insensitive name filter and a result limit.
explanation: The search term is interpolated straight into the SQL string. A query like `x' OR 1=1; DROP TABLE products; --` runs arbitrary SQL. The limit is parameterized, which makes it look safe at a glance, but the user-controlled value isn't.
whyAiDoesThis: Template literals make string-built SQL look tidy, and models often parameterize the 'obvious' numeric value while interpolating the string they're pattern-matching into a LIKE clause.

title: Count lines across files
prContext: Added a CLI helper that totals the line count across every file passed on the command line.
explanation: defer runs when the function returns, not at the end of each loop iteration. Every file stays open until countLines finishes, so passing a few thousand paths exhausts the process's file descriptor limit with 'too many open files'.
whyAiDoesThis: `defer f.Close()` right after `os.Open` is the single most common Go idiom in training data, so models emit it reflexively even inside loops where it doesn't belong.
